title: Evaluating waist-to-hip ratio in youth using frequency-modulated continuous wave radar and machine learning.
summary: The primary study applies ML to radar measurements for youth waist-to-hip-ratio assessment, a specific health-measurement result; the paper calls for more participants and further evaluation before health-risk use.
